note: #117 (US-SAF-4): a small labelled list for a manual live run of the safety classifier. It is not the clinical test set (US-SAF-7 owns that) and is not used for tuning. Each message is classified alone; a context case lists earlier messages of the same field. Labels: crisis, stress or none. A crisis label must come back as crisis (unsure counts as crisis); stress and none may be either, but never crisis.
